Exit nodes terminate workspace egress, enforce policy, and report flows.

Aliases:

* exitnode

## Usage

```console
coder exit-node
```

## Description

```console
Exit nodes are tailnet peers that workspace agents route outbound TCP, UDP, and DNS traffic through. Each flow is checked against a policy and reported to coderd. Agents older than API 2.14 cannot consume replica-aware configurations. Restart workspaces on the new agent before binding exit nodes.
```
